rubrics.justification: The image appears more consistent with an early blastocyst/cavitating embryo than a solid morula; the response incorrectly states there is no blastocoel and does not adequately assess ICM/TE morphology.
It integrates age, AMH, oocyte yield, endometrium, smoking, sperm parameters, and cycle context reasonably well, though some links to embryo-stage interpretation are overstated.
Overall structure is logical, but the core morphology misclassification weakens downstream conclusions, and some inferences (e.g., trigger timing from MII rate alone) are somewhat speculative.

Recommendations are mostly consistent with IVF practice (smoking cessation, luteal support, consider blastocyst culture), but the morphology assessment is not well aligned with standard embryo-stage interpretation and some statements are overconfident.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and future cycles, including smoking cessation, review of stimulation/trigger strategy, and culture planning, though recommendations could be more nuanced.
